entry.title: Entry #28 in Tremblett v. Tesla, Inc., 1:26-cv-10567
entry.summary: District Judge Angel Kelley: ORDER entered. The Court ADOPTS the parties' proposed 23 scheduling order and sets the following deadlines:SCHEDULING ORDER DEADLINES:Initial Disclosures: Initial disclosures required by Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(a)(1) must be completed by December 15, 2026Amendments to Pleadings: Except for good cause shown, no motions seeking leave to add new parties or to amend the pleadings to assert new claims or defenses may be filed after March 30, 2027Written discovery (requests for production of documents, interrogatories, and requests for admissions) shall be served no later than April 30, 2027All depositions, other than expert depositions, must be completed by September 30, 2027Fact Discovery Final Deadline: All discovery, other than expert discovery, must be completed by October 17, 2027 Plaintiff's trial experts must be designated, and the information contemplated by Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(a)(2) must be disclosed by November 15, 2027Plaintiff's trial experts must be deposed by January 15, 2028 Defendant's trial experts must be designated, and the information contemplated by Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(a)(2) must be disclosed by January 30, 2028 Defendant's trial experts must be deposed by February 28, 2028Dispositive motions, such as motions for summary judgment and motions for judgment on the pleadings, must be filed by April 3, 2028Oppositions to dispositive emotions must be filed within 21 days of service of the motionReply memoranda, not to exceed 10 pages, must be filed within 14 days after service of the opposition papersSur-Reply memoranda are not permittedNOTICE OF HEARINGS:Interim Status Conferences:The parties are directed to confer and submit a joint status report within seven days of each scheduled status conference. The status report shall state: (1) the progress of fact discovery, specifically the status of written discovery, the number of depositions anticipated, noticed, and completed, and any anticipated discovery disputes; (2) whether the parties expect to meet the deadlines in the Court's Scheduling Order and, if not, why, and (3) the status of the parties' private mediation efforts and, as relevant, whether the parties would like to be referred to Alternative Dispute Resolution.1. Status Conference set for 4/1/2027 11:00 AM in Remote Proceeding : Boston : No Public Access before District Judge Angel Kelley. 2. Status Conference set for 8/4/2028 11:30 AM in Remote Proceeding : Boston : No Public Access before District Judge Angel Kelley.3. Status Conference set for 10/19/2027 11:30 AM in Remote Proceeding : Boston : No Public Access before District Judge Angel Kelley. Jury Trial set for 11/6/2028 09:00 AM in Courtroom 8 (In person only) before District Judge Angel Kelley. A final pretrial order shall issue at a later date. (MAL) (Entered: 11/02/2026)
